blocks.text: Is chapter mein Tkinter se desktop interfaces banana aur application ka data relational database mein rakhna shamil tha. Table is ki bunyadi istilahat ikatthi karti hai.

rows: Windows, buttons, menus, text boxes aur doosre graphical ajza se program use karne ka basari tareeqa
Desktop graphical user interfaces ke liye Python ki built-in library

Container jo window ke andar widgets munazzam aur ikatthe karta hai
GUI ka hissa, jaise label, button, entry field, menu ya listbox, jo maloomat dikhaye ya input le
Program jo user ke events ya amal ka jawab de
Rows aur columns wale tables mein data jahan mutalliq data keys se jura ho
Structured Query Language, relational databases mein data banane, sambhalne aur badalne ke liye
